name: agy-setup-audit
description: Finds the silent failures in an Antigravity setup (cut-off rules, skills that never load, duplicate MCP servers, broken hooks, reviewers that can write) and adds a guard against pushes to protected branches.
suggestedPrompts: Audit my Antigravity setup and explain each finding
Why is one of my skills not loading?
Review my hooks.json and custom agents with the setup critic
